title: Structural basis for TORC2 activation
authors: Zou L; Tettamanti MG; Bergmann A; Loewith R; Tafur L
one_liner_zh: 该文研究TORC2复合物的冷冻电镜结构及其膜调控机制，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合，与课题无关。
abstract:
Summary

The Target of Rapamycin Complex 2 (TORC2) is a central node in signaling feedback loops serving to maintain biophysical homeostasis of the plasma membrane (PM). How TORC2 is regulated by mechanical perturbation of the PM is not well understood. To address this, we determined the cryo-electron microscopy structure of endogenous yeast TORC2 to up to 2.2 Å resolution. Our model refines the position and interactions of TORC2-specific subunits, providing a structural basis for the differential assembly of Tor2 into TORC2. Furthermore, we observe the insertion of the pleckstrin-homology domain of the Avo1 subunit into the Tor2 active site, providing a regulatory mechanism by phosphoinositides. Structure-guided functional experiments reveal a potential TORC2 membrane binding surface and a positively charged pocket in the Avo3 subunit that is necessary for TORC2 activation. Collectively, our data suggest that signaling phosphoinositides activate TORC2 by membrane-induced structural rearrangements via concerted action of conserved regulatory subunits.
abstract_zh:
摘要

雷帕霉素靶蛋白复合物2（TORC2）是信号反馈环路中的核心节点，负责维持质膜（PM）的生物物理稳态。TORC2如何受质膜机械扰动调控尚不清楚。为此，我们确定了内源性酵母TORC2的冷冻电镜结构，分辨率高达2.2 Å。我们的模型细化了TORC2特异性亚基的位置和相互作用，为Tor2差异组装成TORC2提供了结构基础。此外，我们观察到Avo1亚基的普列克斯特林同源结构域插入Tor2活性位点，从而提供了一种由磷酸肌醇介导的调控机制。结构引导的功能实验揭示了潜在的TORC2膜结合表面及Avo3亚基中一个对TORC2激活所必需的正电荷口袋。综合来看，我们的数据表明，信号性磷酸肌醇通过膜诱导的结构重排，经由保守调控亚基的协同作用激活TORC2。
